title: Nehru Mahalanobis Strategy
definition: An economic development model adopted in India's Second Five-Year Plan (1956-61) emphasizing heavy industrialization, public sector dominance, and a capital-goods bias to achieve long-term self-reliance.
importanceInUpsc: A foundational topic for GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Planning, Growth & Development) and frequently tested in Prelims regarding economic history, industrial policy resolutions, and planning models.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Nehru Mahalanobis Strategy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Indian economic history post-independence
Overview of Five-Year Plans in India
